conditionTypes.label: Entire site
conditionTypes.description: Every page and post, unless something more specific matches.

conditionTypes.label: All posts
conditionTypes.description: Each individual blog post page — not the list of posts.

conditionTypes.label: Blog index
conditionTypes.description: Only the page that lists your posts (/blog) — individual posts are "All posts".

conditionTypes.label: Inventory
conditionTypes.description: Live inventory browse and detail pages, and the parts catalogue.

conditionTypes.label: Parts
conditionTypes.description: The parts catalogue only. Without this, parts pages use the Inventory template.

conditionTypes.label: Location pages
conditionTypes.description: Every page built from the one-page-per-location template. Generated slugs do not exist until a location does, so a specific-page condition cannot reach them.

conditionTypes.label: A group of pages
conditionTypes.description: Every page tagged with one group.

conditionTypes.label: One location’s page
conditionTypes.description: The generated page for a single location, by its slug.

dataSources.label: Locations
dataSources.description: Every active rooftop, from Admin → Locations. Opening a branch adds a card to every list built on this.

dataSources.label: Brands carried (filter options)
dataSources.description: One row per brand at least one rooftop carries, from Admin → Locations → Brands.

dataSources.label: Service options (filter options)
dataSources.description: One row per service option at least one rooftop offers, from Admin → Locations → Profile.

dataSources.label: Staff
dataSources.description: Sales and service contacts, from the team directory.

gridColumns.label: Grid columns
gridColumns.hint: A column list such as 1fr 1fr, 240px 200px 1fr, or 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr.

zIndex.label: Layer
zIndex.hint: 0–60. Site chrome sits at 70 and above.

aspectRatio.label: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.hint: Width / height, such as 16/9, 4/3 or 1/1. Keeps cards the same shape whatever the image.

background.label: Background
background.hint: A colour, or #000@60% for a translucent scrim.

buttonBackground.label: Button fill
buttonBackground.hint: Applies to every button inside this node, whatever variant it uses.

track.label: Rail
track.hint: The scrolling strip. Defaults to the node itself.

slide.label: Slide
slide.hint: Each item. Must be a direct child of the rail.

dots.label: Dots container
dots.hint: Leave it empty — one dot per slide is generated.

live.label: Live region
live.hint: Where changes are announced. Defaults to the node.

control.label: Filter control
control.hint: A button or input carrying the value to match.

frame.label: Map iframe
frame.hint: Defaults to the first iframe inside.

rotator.autoplay: Milliseconds between slides. Omit to require a click.

filter.match: How a control value is compared: "exact" or "includes".

drawer.lockScroll: Freeze the page behind the panel.

scrollstate.after: Pixels scrolled before the state turns on.

dependentselect.source: Name of the option map published on window.

mapsync.message: Template for the address sent to the map.

anchor.description: An id, so a link can jump to this node. Lower-case, no spaces.

scope.description: A token set name, to restyle this node and everything inside it.

repeat.description: Inside a designed component only: the key of a list prop. This node renders once per item, with that item's fields available to {{bindings}} inside it.

behaviour.description: Client behaviour this node performs. Its parts go on nodes inside.

behaviourOptions.description: Settings for the behaviour, as a JSON object. Ignored if it does not parse.

part.description: The role this node plays in the nearest ancestor behaviour. Space-separate to play several at once — "item control" is a drilldown's middle column, filtered by the level above and filtering the level below. One of: child, close, control, count, dot, dots, empty, frame, item, live, next, panel, parent, prev, slide, toggle, totop, track, trigger.

width.description: How wide the content inside runs. bleed-left/bleed-right align one side to the page grid while the other side runs to the screen edge — the split-section pattern where copy stays on the grid and the photo bleeds.

backgroundVideo.description: A muted, looping clip behind this section's content — the hero-with-video pattern. An uploaded file only: an embed cannot be a background, because a third-party iframe brings its own chrome and swallows every click. Give it a `background` as well, so the section still reads before the clip has loaded and when a visitor has asked for reduced motion.

src.description: Public video URL from the media library (mp4/webm).

poster.description: The frame shown before the clip loads, when motion is reduced, and on the editing canvas. Effectively required: without it the band is empty in all three.

paddingY.description: Vertical padding, on the spacing scale.

align.description: Vertical alignment when the section is taller than its content.

stackOn.description: Width at which the columns stack.

reverseStacked.description: When stacked, show the columns in reverse order.

label.description: What this area is for, shown in the template editor.

sectionId.description: Which shared section to place, by id.

values.description: Content for this placement, keyed by the component's declared prop keys. Anything left out falls back to the prop's default, so a placement need only state what differs.

snapshots.description: Widget data resolved by the platform for this placement, keyed by the widget node's id inside the component. Never hand-written.

data.description: Rows resolved by the platform for each list prop this placement pointed at a data source, keyed by the prop key. Never hand-written.

headingLevel.description: Heading level for this block. Keep one h1 per page.

text.description: Body copy. Plain paragraphs separated by a blank line; inline <strong>, <em> and <a> are allowed.

image.description: An uploaded image, referenced by public URL. Never a base64 data URI.

src.description: Public image URL from the media library.

alt.description: Descriptive alternative text. Required for anything not decorative.

caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image.

url.description: Optional: where clicking the image goes.

video.description: A video: either a file uploaded to the media library (mp4/webm), or a YouTube or Vimeo link. Anything that is not a recognised YouTube or Vimeo URL is treated as a file.

src.description: Public video URL from the media library, or a YouTube/Vimeo page URL.

poster.description: Image shown before playback starts. Strongly recommended for an uploaded file: without it the block is a black rectangle until the visitor presses play, and the editing canvas has nothing to show at all. Ignored by YouTube and Vimeo, which bring their own.

title.description: Accessible title, read by screen readers and shown if the video cannot load.

caption.description: Optional caption shown under the video.

autoplay.description: Start on load. Forces the clip muted, because no browser autoplays audio. Pair with `controls` off and `loop` on for an ambient clip.

controls.description: Show the player controls. On unless turned off.

items.description: A call to action. Prefer `ctaId` referencing the dealer's Buttons library over an inline label/url — a library CTA keeps its label, destination and tagging consistent everywhere it appears.

ctaId.description: Id of an entry in site/buttons.json.

label.description: Inline label. Overrides the library label when both are set.

url.description: Inline destination. Overrides the library destination.

intent.description: Analytics intent, e.g. "get-quote". Defaults to the library value.

headingLevel.description: Heading level for this block. Keep one h1 per page.

html.description: Raw HTML fragment. No <script>, no document shell.

formId.description: Id of a form in the dealer's Forms library (site/forms/<id>.json). Never invent form fields inline — reference a library form so routing, consent and validation stay in one place.

intro.description: One short line under the heading.

widget.description: Widget id from the platform registry, e.g. "locations-map".

snapshot.description: Data resolved by the platform and committed into the page, so the facts are in the static HTML. Never hand-written.

depth.description: How many levels to draw. 1 hides submenus.
